summary: Restored exact proposal, functionality and canonical/rendered source evidence in this attempt. Confirmed the sole correction and all four upstream non-retain reconciliations; acceptance is limited to these changes and contradictions, with retained research inherited unchanged.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations, archive calls, model construction and later consumers distinguish three archive destinations from the runtime HSD_JObj destination. Camera evaluation precedes two independent exact-equality tests. The correction agrees with functionality.md while retaining its selection-success and lifetime uncertainties. Rendered callback roles fit canonical registration sites; supported existing knowledge is retained without equivalent rewrites.

contradictions.reason: The superseded data-flow claim incorrectly included the runtime JObj among archive-symbol destinations. Only three pointers are supplied to archive loading; model setup supplies the fourth pointer's address to lb_80011E24, and trophy and stand integration subsequently consume it.
Accepted deferral of exact .data placement: archive string uses are visible, but source literals do not establish compiled section placement.
Accepted deferral of consecutive 16-byte .sbss layout: four static pointer declarations establish types, not compiled adjacency or section layout.
Accepted deferral of the asserted .sdata2 pool: constant consumers do not establish compiled pool size, ordering or placement.

unresolved: Exact .data string placement, consecutive 16-byte .sbss layout and the asserted .sdata2 pool require compiled evidence.
Precise authored imagery, successful selection and archive topology, and externally managed teardown timing remain inherited uncertainties.
The historical vi1202_OnEnter#r3 entity identity is preserved unchanged.
